description: Auto-assemble a timed sequence of vintage clips into a video timeline based on a description. Returns an ordered list of clips with durations. Great for creating edit lists or storyboards.

query.description: Natural language description of the video sequence (e.g. 'american road trip summer vacation 1960s')

target_seconds.description: Target timeline length in seconds (20-600, default 60)

name: build_rough_cut
